shell_purpose.instructions: `tool_call` is one shell command an AI coding agent ran, as JSON: `command` is the shell command and `arguments.description` (when present) is the agent's own one-line statement of why it ran it. Prefer the stated description when it names a purpose. Which option best describes the PRIMARY purpose of this command? For a compound command, choose the purpose of its main step, not of setup such as cd, date or env.

criteria.explore_code: Read, search or list source code, docs, config or file structure to understand it (cat, sed -n, grep, rg, ls, find, git grep) without changing anything.
criteria.edit_files: Change the CONTENT of project source, docs or test files: write or rewrite a file through python/sed/heredoc, apply a patch, rename or delete source files. Not deploying, copying builds or config into a running service.
criteria.run_tests: Run an existing test suite, a single test, or a test/probe script and read its pass/fail result (pytest, vitest, playwright specs, node test scripts).
criteria.lint_typecheck_build: Run linters, formatters, type checkers, code generators, or build/bundle steps (make lint, ruff, mypy, tsc, npm run build, esbuild, codegen) including rebuilding an artifact before a check.
criteria.git_history: Inspect or change local git state: status, diff, log, branch, checkout, stash, add, commit, rebase, merge, conflict resolution, worktrees.
criteria.forge_collab: Work with the remote forge or tracker: push, pull requests, issues, comments, labels, CI run status or logs (git push, gh, tea, Gitea/GitHub API).
criteria.service_ops: Operate or deploy running services and hosts: start, stop, restart, reinstall, systemctl, docker/compose, swap a build or config into a live service, process or port management, ssh to a host to change it.
criteria.diagnose_runtime: Investigate the live behaviour of a running system: read service logs, check health, processes, ports, resource use, reachability, timings, or whether a background job is still running.
criteria.data_query: Query or modify a datastore or a remote data/observability API to read records: SQL/ClickHouse/psql, Langfuse or LiteLLM APIs, curl to JSON endpoints.
criteria.secrets_config: Discover, read, inject or write credentials, environment variables or tool configuration (ssm, .env, config files, auth tokens).
criteria.dependency_env: Install, upgrade or inspect packages, toolchains or the execution environment (uv, pip, npm install, versions, which, PATH).
criteria.agent_fleet: Coordinate the agent platform itself: Grove workspaces, phase reports, mailbox, watches, todo, sessions (grove ...).
criteria.web_fetch_research: Fetch documentation, web pages or external references to learn something (curl/wget of docs, search APIs), not to operate a service.
criteria.wait_poll: Wait or poll for something to finish: sleep, loops that re-check status, waiting on CI or a background job.
criteria.cleanup_scratch: Remove temporary files, scratch worktrees, probes or leftover processes created during the work.
criteria.visual_verify: Check how a UI or rendered page actually looks or behaves: screenshots, headless-browser renders, DOM or scene inspection, contrast, layout or frame-rate measurements.
criteria.compute_analyze: Run an ad-hoc calculation or analysis over local data with a throwaway script (statistics, colour maths, counting or categorizing records already on disk), not querying a service.
criteria.other: Anything that fits none of the purposes above.
